name: SM_Gravestone_Round_PR
dresses: round-headed headstone 0.8 x 1.05 m, leaning, a cross in worn relief; weather-rounded edges, moss from the foot and on the north face, lichen; a turfed grave mound in front (the stone runs 0.35 m into the ground)

fit.pivot: ground at the foot of the stone; face to -Y, the grave lies toward -Y

material_exception: shared tiling scan sets with a vertex-colour weathering layer (MI_Prop_* / MI_Struct_*), not private bakes and not yet rows of ART_STANDARD.md section 2. Edge wear, stains and soot are per-vertex. A unique bake per prop is the next step where the weaknesses say so.
known_weaknesses: Stone reads as real rock (FieldBoulder scans) with moss and lichen in vertex colour; faults: the cross is two applied bars, no inscription, edges are pinched thin rather than chipped, the turfed mound is a smooth dome with a clean rim against the ground.
